    2. Iterative relaxation of centers using repulsion forces to optimize spacing,

    # This is a common strategy for odd counts or to fill central voids effectively.

    # Using 0.05 and 0.95 gives more flexibility for circles to expand towards boundaries
    # compared to 0.1 and 0.9 used in the previous version.
    centers = 0.05 + 0.9 * centers

    # An approximate ideal diameter for circles, used as a target for repulsion.
